tools.name: shell
tools.documentation: Shell, Description: Executes a shell command and returns stdout/stderr, Command - shell:COMMAND, Example - shell:echo hi

tools.name: memadd
tools.documentation: Memory, Description: Stores temporary context memory for the current session, Command - memadd:TEXT_OR_KEY=VALUE, Example - memadd:User prefers Python

tools.name: search
tools.documentation: Search, Description: Performs web search or extracts URL content, Command - search:QUERY_OR_URL, Example - search:openai api

tools.name: return
tools.documentation: Return, Description: Returns the final answer, Command - return:TEXT, Example - return:Done

tools.name: askuser
tools.documentation: AskUser, Description: Asks the user for information, Command - askuser:TEXT, Example - askuser:Provide location
